amendment: G: centered empirical-score sandwich for native MAP
estimand: True physical a,b,c,d of existing DGP; estimator remains native library MAP, not a Bayesian credible interval or new point estimator.
candidate: V B V, where V is the native full joint inverse penalized observed Hessian and B=N/(N-1) sum_i (s_i-mean(s))(s_i-mean(s))'. s_i is the exact marginal (theta integrated) LIKELIHOOD score, not a complete-data score and not the penalized score. Unlike failed A1, B is an empirical score covariance, never V^-1-P.
parameterization: Native physical a,b,c,d and vcov_labels ordering; full cross-item/cross-parameter covariance retained. No delta transformation or SE scaling. No boundary Wald interval.
bias: The estimator is biased; this covariance correction alone need not repair coverage. Assess original true-parameter coverage and bias independently. No plug-in bias shift with an unaccounted-for derivative is introduced.
DGP: Reuse common.truth/common.simulate; N(0,1), independent Bernoulli; four corners N=3000/10000, J=12/30.

seeds.construction: SeedSequence([model_seed,N,J,replication]); disjoint from old A-D/F runs; no development simulations reused.

precision: Replicate-cluster MCSE of pooled parameter-family coverage <=.005 required, not interval-binomial MCSE. Per-item coverage/MCSE also reported, not automatically individually certified. Planned R is not a precision guarantee; insufficient precision is INCONCLUSIVE, no result-driven extension.
failure: Retain every seed/hash/fit failure. No replacement or retry. Rejected covariance gives no intervals. Failed fits counted in rates and denominator sensitivity, never silently omitted.

execution.parallel: 8 independent model/corner jobs; at most 2 processes/job
execution.feasibility: First 10 planned replications are retained. If projected total exceeds budget, stop INCONCLUSIVE before the remaining campaign; no look at coverage for stopping. Otherwise continue the same fixed planned seeds without rerunning the first ten.
execution.hard_stop: 15 minutes overall development; no new experiment after cutoff.

decision: Certification only if every gate passes at all four corners for a model. If partial/failed, production and registry stay unchanged. Passing covariance identity or unit tests is not coverage certification.
preserve: All failed A1/A2 evidence, native estimators/defaults, item/IRF/information certifications, PR187 UI/export contracts, all unsupported inference gates.
references: Penalized estimating-equation sandwich: bread inverse penalized derivative, meat sampling covariance of unpenalized likelihood score (White 1982 estimating-equation principle).
Bayesian inverse posterior Hessian is curvature, not sampling covariance; biased MAP need not have nominal centered Wald coverage.
